newsitem.title: USA: Armstrong World to respond to Allibert.
newsitem.headline: Armstrong World to respond to Allibert.

text.p: Armstrong World Industries said on Thursday that it would respond at a later date to a letter by France's Sommer Allibert that accused the company of misleading shareholders.

Sommer Allibert's letter, released ealier today, said Armstrong had not been accurate in its comparisons of its bid for Domco, Sommer Allibert's floor-covering business, and a deal struck between Sommer Allibert and Tarkett AG.

Armstrong filed suits in Canada and the U.S. this week against Domco's directors and Sommer Allibert, accusing them of disregarding the rights of minority shareholders by rejecting its buyout offer of C$23 per share.

In addition, Armstrong said the letter released today by Sommer Allibert "does not make the case of added value for Sommer Allibert shareholders or added value for Domco shareholders under the terms of the agreement with Tarkett."
